newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends at day's best as Dow recovers.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends at day's best as Dow recovers.

text.p: The UK's leading FTSE 100 share index ended on a stronger note on Friday, tracking Wall Street higher after the latest U.S. inflation figures eased fears of a near-term U.S. interest rate hike, dealers said.
The blue chip index, which spent most of the session struggling in negative territory, cleared the 4,400 hurdle late in the session and ended 26.6 points higher at 4,424.3.
FTSE 100 advancers beat decliners by a margin of two to one. Total SEAQ volume registered 781 million shares at 1639 GMT.
The Dow, up 75 points when London markets closed, rebounded from Thursday's 160-point spill.
